matching: Exact 64-run target times, folds, label indices and label values. Input is the final 32 positions of each 64-position window; preserve NaN masks and original positions.
training: Independent initialization from original C2 per L/fold/LR, 4 tasks/step, AdamW, no refit; one actual label per task; 16-wide padding masked; loss multiplied by 16 to restore per-target scale.
selection: Same validation-only loss and crossing guard as 64->1; step zero allowed. Fresh original C2 initialization for each fold/LR. Lock all 13 heads before test inference.
aggregation: Equal record weight for MAE/RMSE in SOH ratio units. Compute 1-MSE_model/MSE_LastValue separately per record, then average; negative skills retained. Zero reference error is undefined and counted. R2 is auxiliary only.

review_policy.name: reviewed_native_v3
review_policy.mit_capacity: Native QDischarge is primary. Integral disagreement alone is a review note, not label rejection. Summary/counter agreement is not an independent physical calibration.
review_policy.mit_trace: Aggregate discharge fragments; detect intervening charge and counter reset across gaps. Integrate only observed within-run intervals; never integrate long sampling gaps.
review_policy.other_datasets: NASA absent-charge-log review policy; CALCE and XJTU raw-QC exclusions retained.
review_policy.context: 64 original consecutive record positions. Rejected measurements are NaN inputs; target must be eligible. At least two finite inputs for the linear baseline. No filling or row compression.
review_policy.uncertainty: MIT CV export/current-counter mismatch unresolved; native capacity retained under an explicit measurement-source policy. CALCE unknown physical cycles between files remain unknown.
